item.title: JavaScript Debugging: Why V8 Hides Local Variables from the Debugger
item.description:
“JavaScript Debugging: Why V8 Hides Local Variables from the Debugger”

When stepping through JavaScript code in environments utilizing the V8 engine (like Node.js or Chrome DevTools), a peculiar situation sometimes arises: local variables defined within an outer function become inaccessible or appear undefined when a debugger statement is hit inside a nested function, even if the variable is referenced by that nested function. What mechanisms within V8 cause this scoping disconnect during inspection?
